promotionCandidates.title: Split the monolithic lint-ratchet shell smoke by subject ownership

evidence.measurement: 5,059 lines with 73 # smoke-subjects entries in one shell suite at AUDIT_TARGET_SHA.
evidence.note: One test file owns lint-ratchet adapter, kernel, governance, Git-rail, merge-driver, hook, documentation, ESLint, and repository-config subjects.
The header maps dozens of independently changing subject families to this single smoke suite.
Changed-mode resolves changed paths to whole smoke-test files, so any mapped subject selects the complete 5,059-line suite.

promotionCandidates.problem: A single 5,059-line shell smoke owns 73 subjects spanning several independently changing lint-ratchet and Git-rail families. Changed-mode selects at suite granularity, so touching any mapped subject drags the entire suite into the gate and leaves unrelated contracts coupled to one navigational and execution unit.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Extract one coherent subject cluster per slice—merge-driver/Git-rail, governance/config, then kernel/CLI—moving each cluster's smoke-subject ownership and leaving every remainder independently runnable.
